It scans AI coding tools installed on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VSCode, etc.), collects existing Skills, Agents and session history, and uses a 7-step evolution pipeline to automatically discover high-frequency repetitive workflows and generate installable Skill drafts. All data stays local by default and nothing is uploaded.
